camel_example: aliyun esa ListBotInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000' --SortBy CreateTime --SortOrder desc
description_en: Queries the list of Bot security instances
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-bot-instances --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --status online --instance-id sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBotInstances

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. By default, the results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

CreateTime: purchase time.
ExpireTime: expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

CreateTime：新购时间。
ExpireTime：到期时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标识，默认为降序。支持：

asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number for the paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。默认值为 1。取值范围为：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for the paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: The instance is running normally.
offline: The instance has expired but has not exceeded the retention period and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released.
overdue: The instance has an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。支持：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: instance_id

InstanceInfo.description_en: The instances that match the specified conditions under the current account
InstanceInfo.description_zh: 查询到的该用户下符合条件的实例

BotInstanceLevel.description_en:
The Bot protection instance level. If this parameter is empty, the plan does not include a Bot protection instance. If a value is returned, the plan includes a Bot protection instance. Valid values:

enterprise_bot: web edition.

enterprise_bot_with_app: app edition
BotInstanceLevel.description_zh:
为空时，套餐未购买BOT防护实例；
返回值时，套餐购买BOT防护实例，取值：

enterprise_bot web版

enterprise_bot_with_app APP版

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was purchased. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例的新购时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ReserveReleaseTime.description_en: The scheduled release time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ReserveReleaseTime.description_zh: 预约释放时间，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

SiteInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the associated site plan instance
SiteInstanceId.description_zh: 关联站点套餐实例 ID

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: The instance is running normally.
offline: The instance has expired but has not exceeded the retention period and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released.
overdue: The instance has been stopped due to an overdue payment
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费停服状态

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
